hooks.name: Enforce environment variable usage for paths
hooks.description: Block hardcoded paths, force use of $LOCAL_KILOMBO_DIR and other env variables

action.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Check if command contains hardcoded paths to workspace
if echo "$1" | grep -qiE "(/root/JOB-sda2/KILOMBO)"; then
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"⚠️  HARDCODED PATH DETECTED: This command contains a hardcoded path to the workspace. Use $LOCAL_KILOMBO_DIR, $LOCAL_KILOMBO_BUILD, or $LOCAL_WORKSPACE_ROOT instead. See .kiro/steering/use-env-vars.md for correct syntax."}}'
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
